title: PLAYER 2 SEES THE OVERSEER AND LATE SENTRIES AT FULL REACH
why: Bodies the host makes after the raid is built (THE OVERSEER, wave, lockdown and stronghold sentries and wardens) reach player 2 only through the new body word, which never said the body is the boss or how far it reaches, so player 2 window gave them the default reach of 100 and no boss mark. Proven in a staged pair: the Overseer made by bossTick and fed to player 2 through netOnMsg had no boss mark and reach 100 (the host 868), so his sweep laser was never drawn, his charge lane was 115 long and 8 wide instead of 998 and 12, a late sentry lane was 115 instead of 391, and his rounds on the venting Overseer did 180 instead of 270. Now the new body word carries the boss mark and the reach, and player 2 window takes them. The same mark ends two more gaps: player 2 rounds into the Overseer front were soaked to 40 percent as a plain Warden's, with the WARDEN ARMOUR line, while the host's are not, and a late sentry's sight cone was drawn at reach 100. The boss mirror runs no brain in a linked window, so nothing else changes.
now: In co-op, player 2 now sees THE OVERSEER's sweeping laser and full charge lane, late sentries warn him at their real reach, and his rounds hit the venting Overseer as hard as player 1's.
